_comment: Sign-off smoke test for shared Metabase report cards. After editing ANY card, run: node scripts/verify-report-live.js --manifest scripts/report-cards.manifest.json — every entry must return live, non-empty results or the edit is NOT signed off. Test the heaviest org for each card (biggest = worst case for timeouts). Add a card+org row here whenever a new shared card or large org is onboarded. org_ids come from the ORGS map in server.js; card UUIDs are the public UUIDs (SHARED_UUIDS / per-org mbUuid).
